arguments.rationale:
Phase: interpretation of the completed, sealed Batch1 ranking-only prospective campaign (scenario incumbent_checkpoint_20_new_clock, batch 1). Weights held at [0.075, 0.15]; incumbent retained. Both candidates m5campaign-b1-r1 and m5campaign-b1-r2 were fully evaluated, so actual validation savings are exactly zero — a measured fact, not a forecast.

Indexing correction: local errors are indexed by TIME, not candidate. There are four candidate checkpoints but only two distinct state/input/time cases — update 20 at end_s 0.21 (.20-.21) and update 30 at end_s 0.31 (.30-.31). The two candidates' forecast states and commands are identical (forecast_states_identical, forecast_commands_identical true), so their local predictions, errors and scores coincide; the "4 resolved intervals" are two cases x two directions, not four independent results.

Direction, reported separately: coverage 1.0, 2 correct and 2 incorrect (accuracy 0.5 among resolved). Both candidates forecast "increasing" correctly at end_s 0.21, but both forecast "decreasing" at end_s 0.31 while the observed change increased — a wrong sign confined to the late interval.

Numerical support, separate from direction and accuracy: 4/4 stable and converged; successive differences at 0.00025/0.000125 s are ~1e-16 m and ~1e-14 m/s. These are resolution differences, convergence diagnostics, not physical-error bounds.

Quantitative accuracy, separate: against the ORIGINAL M5 tolerances (position 1e-6 m; vector/speed 1e-4 m/s), position error norms 1.54e-4 m and 1.84e-4 m are ~150-185x the position limit, giving 0/4 position passes; endpoint speed errors -4.73e-3 and -6.63e-3 m/s and velocity error norms 8.49e-3 and 9.50e-3 m/s exceed 1e-4 m/s, giving 0/4 speed and 0/4 vector passes. Numerical convergence passes while original accuracy gates fail.

Full-task: both candidates miss 35 deadlines; terminal_error 0.0162 m / 0.0093 m; holding_max_error 0.0263 / 0.0251 m (~2.5x the 0.01 m limit); holding_max_speed 1.149 / 0.907 m/s (~45-57x the 0.02 m/s limit); joint_acceptance false for both.

Sealed decision and conditional ranking scope: the frozen decision abstains for both candidates (eligibility resolved 0/2, coverage 0.0). Their predicted holding/terminal position 0.0391 m exceeds the 0.01 m gate and the predicted speed difference is zero, so eligibility is unresolved. No candidate is rejected, so avoided cost is exactly zero — the instrumented evaluation costs (692-710 s) are not a saving comparator. The recorded actual sampled-speed order is r2 (0.15) then r1 (0.075), gap 0.2417 m/s, but because ranking is conditional on position feasibility and both are position-infeasible, no eligible winner exists and the sealed order is null; pairwise order verdict unresolved, false rejection false, predicted-safe-observed-violating list empty.

Economics, actual receipts so far only: forecast/incremental pair cost 328.594 s; actual evaluations avoided 0; actual validation savings 0 s; counterfactual net saving versus one rejected complete evaluation -328.594 s (negative). required_research_s 0; final research receipted false. This call's future cost is not guessed.

Continuation gates reassessed unchanged: complete evaluations (true), local numerical passes (true), no local/full-history false-safe (true) are satisfied; resolved correct ranking (false), positive counterfactual net saving (false), accepted CONTINUE_BATCH2 (false) are not. Gates fail, so batch2 is not authorized and readiness is STOP.

Recommendation replaced (not executed, no tuning): the prior zero-held-step comparison cannot falsify a nonzero-interval speed-direction error, since zero held steps cannot reproduce a nonzero-interval speed change. Instead, one bounded, coherent investigation with an explicit criterion: on one fresh registered reset-clock episode at the incumbent checkpoint, replay the identical sealed .30-.31 interval and test whether the predictor's projected velocity-vector sign matches the full-task backend sign over that interval; pass if it reproduces the observed increasing direction within the frozen numerical tolerance, fail if the wrong sign persists. Any new method version requires untouched fresh prospective evidence.

Remaining original M5 failures (no threshold relaxed): position/terminal accuracy, speed and vector accuracy, late-interval direction sign, resolved ranking and repeatability, real-time operation.

Authority: experimental offline diagnostic only — no safety, eligibility, promotion, broad-reliability or milestone-closure claim.
